content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, brown, shriveled leaf that appears completely dead and necrotic. The leaf is curled/distorted with uniform brown coloration throughout, no green tissue remaining.

Key observations:
- Entire leaf is uniformly brown/tan and dead
- Leaf appears shrunken and distorted
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty deposits (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No discrete dark lesions with orange/tan centers typical of Anthracnose
- The whole leaf tip/branch appears to have died back completely — consistent with Die_Back, where shoot tips and leaves die progressively from the tip inward

This pattern of complete tissue death with a shriveled, desiccated brown leaf is most consistent with Die_Back, which causes progressive death of shoots and leaves from the tips.
